AntiPattern.Bad: `try { await client.reserveStock(''); expect.fail('should have thrown'); } catch (e) { expect((e as Error).message).toContain('idempotency'); }` AND inspecting `client._inflightCount` with `@ts-expect-error`.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Manual `try/catch + expect.fail` instead of `rejects.toThrow` (`AX_VITEST_ASSERT_API_CHOICE`). `toContain` on `error.message` (inherited `AX_PARTIAL_STRING_VIA_MATCH`). Inspecting protected internal field (inherited `AX_CONTRACT_OVER_IMPLEMENTATION`).
AntiPattern.Good: `await expect(client.reserveStock('')).rejects.toThrow(/idempotency.*empty|empty.*idempotency/i);` and subscribe to public lifecycle event for observation.
